summary: Shell research program phase 6 after a dive wave: one opus agent harvests the new consolidations, appends the landing report to the topic map, applies the stop condition, and commissions the next wave (revised staged briefs plus follow-ups) or declares ready-to-draft with binding authoring notes

harvest.verdict_reason:
The wave-plan stop condition is not met. Wave 2 produced 124 new MUST rules and new failure classes:
- container-job sh -e (SH-CI-04)
- WinPS writer mixing (SH-CI-11)
- PROMPT_COMMAND element 0 (SH-EMIT-24)
- Taskfile item scope (SH-CI-17)
- PSSA fail-open (PS-GATE-01/02)

Eight families have no consolidation: SH-INST, SH-SEC, SH-TEST, SH-ZSH, SH-FISH, SH-NU, SH-ELV and PS-SEC. Load-bearing questions are still open but answerable now by fixture runs on this host: the verification dialect (X1/M-X-05), the SC2312 burn-down (X4), pwsh 7.6 encoding on Windows, and completions and dir-hooks. No held-out round has run.
